description: This file implements an ARM-specific stack walker for the Google Breakpad crash reporting system, including methods for retrieving call stack frames using CFI, stack scanning, and frame pointer techniques.

classes.name: StackwalkerARM
classes.description: ARM-specific implementation of a stack walker for processing call stacks in crash reports.

classes.name: StackFrameARM
classes.description: Represents a stack frame specific to ARM architecture, including context and validity flags.

methods.name: GetContextFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the current context as a stack frame, including instruction pointer.

methods.name: GetCallerByCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Uses CFI data to recover the caller's stack frame.

methods.name: GetCallerByStackScan
methods.description: Attempts to find the caller's frame by scanning the stack.

methods.name: GetCallerByFramePointer
methods.description: Uses frame pointer register and memory to find the caller's frame.

methods.name: GetCallerFrame
methods.description: Main method to get the caller's frame, trying CFI, frame pointer, and stack scan methods.
